parts.text:
The lengths, in centimetres, of two types of insect, $A$ and $B$, are modelled by the random variables $X \sim \text{N}(6.2, 0.36)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(2.4, 0.25)$ respectively.

Find the probability that the length of a randomly chosen type $A$ insect is greater than the sum of the lengths of 3 randomly chosen type $B$ insects.
